purpose: Common V&V gate for promotion from Owner-accepted bounded use to stable.
applies_to: All existing QF_solver elements, solvers and analysis scopes.

policy.final_relative_error_policy: From this baseline onward, every primary V&V comparison observable must be <= 1 percent relative error. This limit applies to stable-promotion decisions and to any claim that a validated scope is closed. Values above 1 percent block stable or closure unless a formal mechanical justification, additional convergence study and explicit Owner decision are recorded.
policy.singularity_policy: Point peaks at singularities are informative only and cannot be the sole acceptance observable.

owner_review_contract.stable_rule: promotion_target=stable requires a signed Owner decision and passing technical criteria; the matrix is changed only by an explicit controlled release action.

common_criteria.title: Independent representative cases
common_criteria.rule: At least three independent geometries or loading families are required, and at least one must differ from the development case.

common_criteria.title: Reference correlation
common_criteria.rule: Use an analytical, published, experimental or external-solver reference when comparable; otherwise record a justified NOT_APPLICABLE.

common_criteria.title: Recommendations closed or converted to explicit limits
common_criteria.rule: Every critical recommendation must point to a passing artifact or an accepted scope boundary.

common_criteria.title: Dated Owner decision for this scope

decision_rules.stable: All ST-C01..ST-C09 PASS or justified NOT_APPLICABLE; no critical recommendation open.
decision_rules.owner_accepted: Owner decision exists but one or more stable criteria remain open without a critical safety concern.
decision_rules.accepted_with_recommendations: Technical evidence is usable and recommendations remain active.
decision_rules.accepted_for_bounded_engineering_use: Evidence supports only the explicitly bounded domain.
decision_rules.experimental: Implementation is usable for development or controlled studies but lacks stable evidence.
decision_rules.research: Evidence is insufficient for engineering use.
